security_updates.runtime_dependencies: The pinned runtime/native payload is inherited from the 3.9.1 release already reviewed on 2026-10-11; no new Linux runtime dependency was changed. Official PyPI records show aiohttp 3.14.5 (2026-10-11), cryptography 50.0.2, websockets 17.2, Pillow 12.3.0 and argon2-cffi-bindings 26.1.0 as the package versions used by that release. The embedded editor uses prosemirror-view 1.42.6, above the advisory fixed version 1.42.3.
security_updates.advisory: The older npm/tooling workspace for archived TOAST UI remains out of the AppImage; the shipped bundle is the reviewed patched bundle. Historical native exposure exceptions remain in SECURITY-REVIEW.md.

validation.source_test_command: pytest -q tests with candidate src on PYTHONPATH
validation.appimage_gui_smoke: passed on local GTK/WebKit display; WebKitGTK 2.54.0; editor lock/scroll/CSP/revisions, language settings and PDF export exercised
validation.packaging_method: Reused the verified 3.9.1 AppImage runtime and native dependency payload, overlaid the candidate application package, and rebuilt the SquashFS image with mksquashfs. This was tested as a final AppImage but was not a full rebuild of WebKitGTK/native libraries. Python wheel and sdist were built from the candidate source; archive owner metadata was normalized.

privacy.assessment: Matches are within upstream system/cryptography components; none are in Notestr source or account data. They are retained as a review finding, not evidence of absence of all personal data.
privacy.history: previously public author identities in old commits are retained; no history rewrite
privacy.limitations: Targeted checks only; they cannot detect unknown identities or all encoded data. No real account or user notes were used.
